instance_name.description: Name for this instance of ssh-agent-filter, displayed during confirmation prompts.

debug_mode.description: If true, show debug info and do not fork.

all_confirmed.description: If true, allow all other keys with confirmation.

comment_confirmed.description: List of key comments to allow with confirmation.

fingerprint_confirmed.description: List of key MD5 fingerprints (hex-encoded) to allow with confirmation.

key_confirmed.description: List of base64-encoded public keys to allow with confirmation.

comment_keys.description: List of key comments to allow without confirmation.

fingerprint_keys.description: List of key MD5 fingerprints (hex-encoded) to allow without confirmation.

key_keys.description: List of base64-encoded public keys to allow without confirmation.

ssh_askpass_cmd.description: Command to run for confirmation questions, passed via SSH_ASKPASS environment variable.
